snippet.title: BrokenLore: Don't Lie - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for BrokenLore: Don't Lie, a psychological horror spin-off game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will explore a narrative where lies, medication, and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare. BrokenLore: Don't Lie is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GoG), with a demo available now on Steam.
